description:
Bored of vanilla ChatGPT?

Caveman Mode transforms it into different characters, personalities, and speaking styles. Switch from a prehistoric caveman to a swashbuckling pirate, a wise wizard, a cynical detective...

Whether you’re writing, brainstorming, learning, roleplaying, or just having fun, Caveman Mode makes every conversation more entertaining and memorable.

Features

* Instantly switch between unique AI personalities
* Browse a growing library of characters and speaking styles
* Create more engaging roleplay and storytelling experiences
* Make learning more fun with themed tutors and experts
* Customize how ChatGPT responds without changing what it can do
* Discover new ways to brainstorm, write, and explore ideas

The most popular characters

* Caveman
* Pirate
* Wizard
* Detective
* Shakespeare
* Solider
* Drill sergeant
* And many more

Transform your AI. Change the personality. Keep the intelligence.
